court_name: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH AT AMARAVATI
petitioner: GILAKALAGIRI, HINDU, R/O. KUKKALAGUDA VILLAGE, YERPEDU MANDAL, CHITTOOR DISTRICT.
respondent: THE STATE OF ANDHRA PRADESH, The Public Prosecutor, High Court of Telangana and A.P Hyderabad.

directives.text: In the result, the present Criminal Appeal is dismissed confirming the conviction and sentence recorded by the learned I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Chittoor in Sessions Case No.15 of 2014, dated 26.07.2018.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in the Criminal Appeal, shall stand closed.

raw_summary: The Andhra Pradesh High Court dismissed Criminal Appeal No. 2612/2018, affirming the conviction and life sentence of the appellant, Gilakalagiri, as imposed by the I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Chittoor. The court found that the prosecution had proven beyond reasonable doubt the appellant's guilt for offenses under Sections 363, 302 IPC, and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, relating to the kidnapping, rape, and murder of a minor girl. The judgment relies on circumstantial evidence, including the 'last seen' theory and medical evidence.
